maturity_states.tested: deterministic or automated test exercises declared behavior
maturity_states.integration_proven: required components have executed together across the actual integration seam
maturity_states.dogfood_proven: capability has been exercised on unrelated or authentic real project work
maturity_states.release_qualified: exact immutable release candidate has required qualification evidence
maturity_states.owner_promoted: explicit release authority selected that exact qualified candidate as stable

rule: Higher maturity is never inferred from a lower state. Documentation and commit messages are provenance, not behavior proof.

entries.subject: repository version identity
entries.claim: VERSION contains v0.1.0 and package.json contains 0.1.0; no release manifest binds that version to an immutable installed artifact.

entries.subject: agent authority model
entries.claim: agents/manifest.json defines nine roles. Only coder has may_edit=true; no role has may_stage/may_commit/may_push. Committer prepares semantic closeout rather than owning Git mutation.
contradictions: README.md still describes eight specialized subagents

entries.subject: governance authority boundary
entries.claim: M4 contracts explicitly separate capability, constitutional authority, runtime permission, identity evidence, governance validity, and admission. Future skills/TaskSpecs are required to translate into the same admission engine.
contradictions: agents/manifest.json retains legacy compatible_skills metadata that must not become a parallel authorization mechanism

entries.subject: Wayfinder boundary
entries.claim: Wayfinder is a read-only uncertainty assessor, not a planner; retained architecture text reports bounded FreeLLMAPI qualification with subject/binding match and ledger provenance.

entries.subject: M6 production skill catalog
entries.claim: Six production skill protocol directories exist and M6.5 deterministic proof asserts exact catalog membership, unique fingerprints, M4 admission, projection drift checks, and deterministic qualification fixtures.
contradictions: ROADMAP.md stops at M6.1 while repository contains M6.2-M6.5 work

entries.subject: M6 live qualification
entries.claim: All six production protocols require live qualification. Five skill qualification directories contain only .gitkeep; TDD retains failed/transient/execution attempts but no repository-visible successful live qualification artifact.

entries.subject: current install/runtime materialization
entries.claim: stageCandidate copies artifacts from a discovered mutable source checkout into a timestamped staging directory and writes VERSION, but does not record source commit, artifact digest, or release manifest.

entries.subject: current promotion semantics
entries.claim: installer and harness update validate a staged copy then immediately replace ~/.local/share/ocode-harness, reinstall launchers/agents/config, and post-validate. Candidate evaluation and promotion authority are not separate persisted states.
contradictions: deploy.mjs comments describe stable/dev separation, but exact stable/candidate/dev release identities are not represented

entries.subject: current rollback semantics
entries.claim: rollback restores the newest timestamped backup directory and deletes the consumed backup; it does not select a prior immutable release manifest and therefore does not itself preserve complete failed-release/release-lineage evidence.

entries.subject: CI coverage
entries.claim: No .github directory was present at the baseline tree, so no GitHub Actions CI is repository-visible. Validation authority is currently expressed through local scripts/tests unless external CI exists outside the repository.

entries.subject: top-level documentation freshness
entries.claim: README.md and older architecture/installation text describe an eight-agent v0.1 system and empty skills while current source has nine roles and six production skill protocols.
contradictions: top-level descriptive docs are stale relative to source

entries.subject: legacy roadmap freshness
entries.claim: ROADMAP.md declares M6 ACTIVE but stops its concrete status at M6.1 and ends by saying M6-M10 remain planned; current source includes M6.2 qualification machinery and M6.3-M6.5 catalog work.
contradictions: legacy roadmap cannot be active authority without revision

entries.subject: local deterministic validation surface
entries.claim: package.json defines broad local tests and acceptance commands covering install/update/rollback, governance, execution, evidence, Wayfinder, qualification, and M6 catalog work. This planning session did not execute the full repository suite because the connected GitHub environment exposes repository contents but no checkout/runtime.

entries.subject: OpenCode integration seam
entries.claim: Repository architecture records OpenCode 1.18.21 as known-good and reports real FreeLLMAPI/OpenAI execution through explicit agent JSON runs plus sanitized export; provider/model binding is runtime overlay policy and credentials remain external.

active_program_authority.authority: program/README.md -> program/roadmap.json if accepted by owner
active_program_authority.baseline: This branch proposal is not authority on main until owner accepts/merges it.

superseded_program_authority.ROADMAP.md: Preserved under program/history and replaced at root with an explicit supersession pointer on this review branch.

module_responsibilities.packages/harness-runtime: identity, lifecycle, ledger, evidence, verification, governance/admission, execution, deployment, wayfinding, governed skills
module_responsibilities.agents: semantic role definitions and structured role authority manifest
module_responsibilities.profiles: provider/model binding policy separate from semantic roles
module_responsibilities.skills: Ocode-owned governed engineering methods and qualification provenance
module_responsibilities.scripts: doctor, acceptance, qualification and maintenance command surfaces

authority_boundaries.mutation: coder may edit; agents do not own stage/commit/push according to agents/manifest.json; deterministic runtime owns governed Git closeout mechanisms
authority_boundaries.verification: verifier/test execution supplies evidence, not acceptance authority
authority_boundaries.review: reviewer evaluates independently; review does not itself promote releases
authority_boundaries.acceptance: runtime closeout and historical milestone docs contain acceptance gates, but owner-level program/release acceptance is not currently represented as a release manifest state
authority_boundaries.release: current installer/update code can replace installed runtime after validation; explicit separate release-promotion authority is missing and is the MS-R1 gap

integration_proven_historical: M2 OpenCode FreeLLMAPI/OpenAI seam per retained architecture report
M5 bounded Wayfinder qualification per retained architecture report
capability_state.dogfood_proven: UNKNOWN for current catalog/release topology; repository does not provide a canonical dogfood ledger at program level
capability_state.release_qualified: NO repository-wide immutable release manifest proves this state
capability_state.owner_promoted: NO repository-wide promotion record proves this state

paths.current_version_identity: VERSION=v0.1.0 plus package version 0.1.0; insufficient as exact release identity
paths.evidence_path: project .opencode/run-ledger.jsonl for runs plus repository-retained milestone/qualification evidence

persistence_and_recovery.implemented: run ledger plus installation backups/rollback primitives
persistence_and_recovery.unproven: TaskSpec-level restart/recovery, stale/conflicting execution state recovery, idempotent replay across mutation classes, immutable release rollback lineage

learning_and_provenance.provenance: ledger/evidence/fingerprints and retained failure evidence exist in multiple subsystems
learning_and_provenance.learning: no accepted longitudinal learning/evaluation loop; historical M10 concept remains future

coverage.tests: broad local Node test suite and milestone acceptance scripts are declared in package.json
coverage.ci: no repository-visible .github Actions directory at baseline
coverage.current_session_execution: full npm test and live provider acceptance were not executable through the connected GitHub repository API

architecture_debt: release identity/promotion currently version-and-directory based rather than immutable manifest based
top-level README/architecture/installation documentation is stale relative to nine-role and M6 source reality
legacy compatible_skills metadata remains in agent manifest and must not become parallel authorization
current run lifecycle vocabulary is not suitable as program-planning lifecycle and must remain separate
temporary_or_version_specific_adapters: OpenCode 1.18.21 bounded subagent execution uses an ephemeral mode: primary overlay for the explicitly invoked role
unresolved_decisions: whether an existing v0.1.0 installation should be forensically imported into the managed release registry
whether multi-project/team/extension capabilities ever become required rather than conditional strategic directions
